patch_description: Introduce a two-gate perimeter ring to enrich entanglement motifs: add a CRX ring around the outer 8 qubits, followed by a CRY ring on the same perimeter edges, both sharing a single angle per ring. This increases expressive power with minimal depth overhead (two gates per edge instead of CZ), aligns with adjacency constraints, and uses separate parameter keys ("crx_ring" and "cry_ring") for efficient feature reuse. Expect improved validation/test performance due to richer ring-based entanglement patterns while maintaining compatible parameter-shared structure.
